Cellular Automata

2026-11-16 10:08 PM

Think Complexity

This book has a lot of interesting simulations for complex systems, with Python programs using numpy and cross-correlation kernels. I am interested in implementing these 2D discrete models, mostly related to cellular automata.

  • Percolation cellular automaton
  • Drossel-Schwabl forest-fire model
  • Abelian sand pile model
  • Sugarscape (agent-based model)

While not part of the book, a related topic is lattice-gas cellular automata, a simple model for simulating fluid flows. I have spent the past couple days making a visualiser in Python: https://github.com/allanwupi/lattice-gas-automata.
